title: The bandit is not the ruler of the world, Chapter 55 - ATV
description: The bandit is not the ruler of the world 55th episode summary: Khidr Cakirbeyli pays the price of keeping the CIA heavy. It will be very difficult for them to stand strong in the face of the persecution of the place where they are held.  The reason for the disappearance of Çakırbeylis is understood in a short time. Ünal Kaplan is ready for all kinds of bargaining as he knows that Khidr will lead to weakness.  Ercüment, who wants to sit on the table, wants everyone's game. Ilyas never approaches such a bargaining. He knows that his brother will condone his son's death if necessary in the face of these circumstances. If the table members know that Khidr will want to die rather than compromise, if they submit to Ercüment's wishes.   On the other hand, David, in the hands of his nephew CIA, takes action for the operation.  The Suzi acting with Ünal will also show his power in the face of those.  Mary and Ceylan come together around the same pain. Although Mary wants to hide the people of the house, Hayriye immediately understands that something is going wrong. Because of what happened to his family, he has no power. Nevertheless, he does not leave the methane.   Players: Oktay Kaynarca (Hızır Çakırbeyli), Deniz Çakır (Meryem Çakırbeyli), Sanem Çelik (Ceylan), Tarık Ünlüoğlu (Ünal Kaplan), Yunus Emre Yıldırımer (Alpaslan Çakırbeyli), Ozan Akbaba (İlyas Çakırbeyli), Sabina Toziya (Hayriye Çakırbeli), Tuna Orhan (reserve Karademir) Sinan Demirer (Chick-Yunus Tokgöz) https://www.facebook.com/atv   https://twitter.com/atvcomtr    https://www.instagram.com/atvturkiye/   https://plus.google.com/112209224205756784214/posts    https://www.youtube.com/channel/ucuvz7t_kwkxdogfcdlfi-hg   ATV official youtube channel Subscribe, don't miss anything!
